content.rendered:
We invite all 8th grade families to join us for the promotion of Sherwood Charter School’s 8th grade students!

Wednesday, June 4th, 2025
5:30 pm to 6:30
Sherwood Charter School Auditorium

A promotion reception will be held immediately following the ceremony in the gym.

*If your student is participating in the ceremony, please have them dress in uniform or nicer and arrive to Mrs. Iliscupidez’s classroom no later than 5:15 pm. They will be walking over to the auditorium as a class for the ceremony.
